svg.title: OpenHeronBrowser engine architecture
svg.desc: Shell on the UI thread. One thread per tab: parse, script, DOM, style, layout, paint. Network worker pool for fetches. Shared text system for fonts and shaping.
svg.text: thread per tab · navigation · event loop · resource loading · frames
Same colors as the performance overlay (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P)
